title: Hidden and Revealed Members: The Body as Likeness of the Father
description: From the observation that the body has both hidden inner members and revealed outer members, the teaching builds a sustained correspondence: the Father dwells hidden in his Greatness while the two ships of light (sun and moon as the body's eyes) and the proclaiming tongue (Jesus the Radiance) are his revealed members, sent forth to manifest every matter, including the wound of the Living Soul and her healing.
